cc:Work.dc:title: Weekly fire detections in Bolivia
cc:Work.dc:description: Retrospective temporal test in Bolivia, 2023–2025, covering 3,127,636 cell-weeks. Dataset: 25,184,988 cell-weeks, 2013–2025. At a weekly budget of 10% of eligible area, the climatology baseline covered 39.7% and calibrated LightGBM (Bolivia Fire) 55.8% of detection-positive cell-weeks. Climatology uses training detection frequency by cell and time of year; LightGBM uses satellite detections acquired before each week. A cell-week is one 0.05-degree grid cell during a seven-day target interval. 106 of 157 test weeks met the observation requirements. Source: arXiv:2611.08539v1, Table 3.
